questions.prompt: Lily and Lucy had a lot of homework to do, so ________ of them went to the park.
questions.topicReason: 考查 both/neither/either/none 等不定代词在两者语境中的辨析。

questions.sourceFile: 2025上海初三英语二模16区试卷.pdf
questions.prompt: It’s necessary to learn to accept failure as ________ can succeed all the time.
questions.topicReason: 句意为没有人能一直成功，考查nobody等不定代词辨析。

questions.sourceFile: 2025上海初三英语二模16区试卷.pdf
questions.prompt: I had sent three postcards to Mia from Singapore, but she got ________ of them.
questions.topicReason: three postcards对应none表示三者或以上一个也没有，考查不定代词辨析。

questions.sourceFile: 2025上海初三英语二模16区试卷.pdf
questions.prompt: After the big fire, ________ in the building was destroyed.
questions.topicReason: 考查不定代词在语境中的选择，表示建筑物内的事物范围。

questions.sourceFile: 2025上海初三英语二模16区试卷.pdf
questions.prompt: There are eight planets in the solar system. Four are small and rocky and ________ are gas giants.
questions.topicReason: 考查 the others 表示特定范围内剩余的全部行星。

questions.sourceFile: 2025上海初三英语二模16区试卷.pdf
questions.prompt: Mr Black and Mrs Cherry and three ________ teachers were having a meeting this time yesterday.
questions.topicReason: three other teachers 表示“另外三位老师”，考查 other/another/the other 等不定限定词辨析。

questions.sourceFile: 2025上海初三英语二模16区试卷.pdf
questions.prompt: The New Year Concert was so fantastic that ________ left in the middle of it.
questions.topicReason: so...that 语境表示音乐会精彩到没人中途离开，考查 nobody 等不定代词。

questions.sourceFile: 【英语】精品解析：2026年上海市崇明区初三下学期英语二模试题（解析版）.pdf
questions.prompt: We need ________ two students to help us clean the room before the meeting begins.
questions.topicReason: another two students 表示“另外两个学生”，考查 another 与数词连用的不定限定用法。

questions.sourceFile: 【英语】精品解析：2026年上海市崇明区初三下学期英语二模试题（解析版）.pdf
questions.prompt: They saw beautiful wildflowers blooming on ________ sides of the road during their drive.
questions.topicReason: both sides of the road 表示道路两边，考查 both 指“两者都”的不定代词/限定词用法。

questions.sourceFile: 【英语官方解析】精品解析：上海市奉贤区2025-2026学年九年级下学期二模英语试卷（解析版）.pdf
questions.prompt: Life may be difficult at times, but with ________ patience, we can always move forward.
questions.topicReason: patience为不可数名词，肯定意义中表示“一点儿”用a little，考查不定数量词辨析。

questions.sourceFile: 【英语官方解析】上海市虹口区2026年下学期九年级中考二模 英语试卷（解析版）.pdf
questions.prompt: I can’t connect my computer to the Internet. There must be ________ wrong with it.
questions.topicReason: There must be something wrong with it为固定表达，something表示“某事/某物”用于肯定判断。

questions.sourceFile: 【英语官方解析】上海市黄浦区2026年九年级中考二模英语试卷（解析版）.pdf
questions.prompt: The Greek soldiers climbed out of the wooden horse one after ________ in the dark.
questions.topicReason: one after another 为不定代词 another 构成的固定表达，表示一个接一个。

questions.sourceFile: 【英语官方解析】精品解析：上海市闵行区2025-2026学年九年级下学期学业质量抽样调研（二模）英语试卷（解析版）.pdf
questions.prompt: My friends were busy today, but ________ of them forgot to send me birthday wishes.
questions.topicReason: 考查不定代词：friends为三者及以上，none of them表示没有一个。

questions.sourceFile: 【英语官方解析】精品解析：上海市普陀区2025-2026学年第二学期九年级命题指导研修英语样卷（解析版）.pdf
questions.prompt: The community center provides free art workshops, but ________ seems to know about them.
questions.topicReason: 根据 but 和语义可知“没人知道”，考查不定代词 nobody。

questions.sourceFile: 【英语官方解析】精品解析：上海市普陀区2025-2026学年第二学期九年级命题指导研修英语样卷（解析版）.pdf
questions.prompt: In the cultural exhibition, there are two ancient Chinese instruments on display: one is a guqin, and ________ is a pipa.
questions.topicReason: 考查两者中的另一个，用one...the other...结构。

questions.sourceFile: 【英语官方解析】上海市青浦区2025-2026学年九年级下学期二模英语试卷（解析版）.pdf
questions.prompt: I think ________ must be done to protect the wetland near the town.
questions.topicReason: 句意为必须做些事情保护湿地，考查不定代词something。

questions.sourceFile: 【英语参考答案】2026年上海初三松江二模英语参考答案【含解析】.pdf
questions.prompt: These are the two ways to solve the problem. You can try this first, and then ________.
questions.topicReason: 考查不定代词辨析：两者中的另一个用the other。

questions.sourceFile: 【英语官方答案】2026年上海市徐汇区中考二模考试英语试题（解析版）.pdf
questions.prompt: John telephoned and asked us to arrange ________ day to discuss the new plan.
questions.topicReason: 考查不定代词another，表示另找一天讨论新计划。

questions.sourceFile: 【英语官方解析】2026年上海市杨浦区中考英语二模试卷（解析版）.pdf
questions.prompt: Many people watched the variety show online, but ________ of them left a review.
questions.topicReason: 考查不定代词 none，表示“三者或三者以上都没有”。

questions.sourceFile: 【英语官方解析】精品解析：上海市长宁区2025学年第二学期初三英语期中试卷（解析版）.pdf
questions.prompt: The system offered two possible solutions to the problem, but ________ of them seemed practical.
questions.topicReason: two possible solutions 且都不实用，用 neither，考查不定代词。
